sourceFile: 6. BRS-161016(DT) Sunmary Report TEST new JIG improve after repair use new dry machine 2024.05.9_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable validation evidence but misstates the changed factor and outcome grouping.
issues: Changed factor is nonsensical and built from totals/row labels.
No explicit normal/baseline condition is cited.
Primary context is new dry machine with improved JIG; height/time/date are subgroups.
Outcome mixes summary totals with trial-round rows without preserved grouping.
requiredUserQuestions: Should this be treated as validation of the new dry machine with improved JIG, not a baseline comparison?
correctionPlan: Set changed condition to new dry machine plus improved JIG for BRS-161016.
Remove uncited baseline or mark baseline as not provided.
Use height, time, temperature, date, and test round as subgroup keys.
Keep NG glue not dry, separation NG, OK, input, and NG rate under one result outcome.
Delete spurious header/stat measurement outcome and cite purpose, content, header, result, and summary rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but grouping support is insufficient until corrected.
